free_tier.stated: No storage quota published. Per-attachment cap is the only hard number: 'Message attachments are limited to 100MB each.'

retention.stated: Retention is governed by the org's retention policy (license-dependent); free-tier spaces are not a documented permanent store

egress.terms: No per-GB egress charge found, but files are fetched by authenticated API call or a short-lived download URL tied to the message. Not an anonymous CDN path.

record.tooling: webexteamssdk / webex-python-sdk; POST /v1/messages with multipart files, GET /v1/contents/{id}. Room Tabs API can attach a persistent URL to a space but does not store bytes.
record.chaining: 100 MB/attachment x unlimited messages in a space is genuinely large in principle, but free Webex accounts have message-retention limits and the org pays per user beyond the free tier.
record.limits_note: 100 MB per attachment. Retention is governed by the org's retention policy (license-dependent); free-tier spaces are not a documented permanent store. Auth required for every read.
record.reliability_note: Retention is policy-driven rather than fixed, so an admin policy change or license lapse can remove content without any API-visible warning. Unverified for the free tier specifically. Blocked from the retention help page.

evidence.proved: read live: 'Message attachments are limited to 100MB each.'
unverified: blocked by challenge (no retention number obtained)
